sectionDesc.overview: What needs attention, how the instance is used, and how it is set up.

admin.cannotDisableSelf: You cannot disable your own account.
admin.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own account.
admin.socialVerifyTtlHint: Treat an email as verified when a linked social account confirms it. Days until it needs verifying again; 0 means never.
admin.allowAltEmailLogin: Allow login with alternate emails (site default)
admin.disableUserCreateTeam: Disable users from creating teams (admins can bypass)
admin.disableUserCreateApp: Disable users from creating OAuth apps (admins can bypass)
admin.disableSsrHint: Render every page in the browser instead of on the server. Useful for troubleshooting.
admin.teamJoinRequirementsHint: Requirements every team enforces. Team owners can add more but can't remove these.
admin.defaultTeamRequireVerifiedEmail: All teams require a verified primary email
admin.subTeamConfigHint: Let teams nest. Members of a team are also members of its sub-teams, with the higher of their two roles.
admin.maxTeamDepthHint: Hard cap on how deep teams can nest (root = 0, so 5 = team → 4 levels of children). 1–20.
admin.inheritTeamMembership: Inherit team membership down the hierarchy
admin.inheritTeamDomains: Inherit verified domains down the hierarchy
admin.loginErrorRetentionDaysHint: How long to keep failed login records. Set to 0 to retain indefinitely.
admin.loginRateLimitsHint: Attempts allowed per time window, in seconds. A password and the 2FA code that follows each count as an attempt.
admin.loginIdentifierRateLimit: Login attempts per email or username
admin.captchaPow: Proof of Work (no server key needed)
admin.captchaDefaultProviderHint: Shown first to visitors. Choose “None” to turn captcha off entirely.
admin.captchaAlternatesHint: Providers a visitor may switch to if the default fails or takes too long. Order is the order they're offered.
admin.captchaSwitchTimeoutHint: How long before the “try a different method” option appears. 0 disables the timed prompt (it still appears on failure).
admin.geetestFailOpen: Accept if GeeTest is unreachable (fail open)
admin.capModeHint: Embedded runs Cap on this site; External uses your own Cap Standalone server.
admin.turnstileEndpointHint: Where the widget loads from. The China host can be faster in mainland China but needs its own site key (below).
admin.turnstileChinaSiteKeyHint: Site key of a separate widget created with region “china” (needs Cloudflare China Network). Leave empty to always use the global host.
admin.socialLeaveBlank: Leave blank to disable a provider.
admin.thirdPartyDesc: Send notifications to users as Telegram or Discord messages.
admin.tgNotifyDesc: Uses the bot of the selected Telegram sign-in source. Users link Telegram and pick events on their Notifications page.
admin.tgNotifyNoSources: No enabled Telegram OAuth sources yet.
admin.discordNotifyDesc: Needs a Discord bot token, separate from the sign-in source's secret. Users link Discord and pick events on their Notifications page.
admin.discordNotifyNoSources: No enabled Discord OAuth sources yet.
admin.emailReceiveHostHint: Domain for inbound verification emails (e.g. mail.example.com). Leave blank to use the APP_URL hostname.
admin.testEmailDesc: Sends a test email to your admin address.
admin.securityTxtDesc: Publishes /.well-known/security.txt so researchers know where to report vulnerabilities, once a contact is set.
admin.securityContactHint: A mailto: address or an https URL where security reports should go. Leave empty to disable security.txt.
admin.securityPolicyUrlHint: Optional. Link to your vulnerability disclosure policy, added to security.txt.
admin.legalDesc: Markdown pages linked from every page's footer. Leave one empty to hide it.
admin.privacyPolicyPlaceholder:
# Privacy Policy

How this service collects, uses, and protects personal data…
admin.termsOfServicePlaceholder:
# Terms of Service

The rules and conditions for using this service…
admin.legalMarkdownHint: Markdown supported. Rendered and sanitized the same way as profile READMEs.
admin.legalHiddenWhenEmpty: Empty — this page and its footer link are hidden.
admin.dangerDesc: Maintenance and one-way migrations live here. Read each section carefully before clicking.
admin.resetEverythingDesc: Deletes all users, apps, tokens, domains and settings, and starts setup again. This can't be undone.
admin.resetSectionDesc: Permanently delete all users, sessions, apps, tokens, and site configuration, then return to the setup screen. This cannot be undone.
admin.resetDisabledDesc: Set the ENABLE_RESET environment variable to expose this command. It is disabled by default to prevent accidental destruction.
admin.resetRequestDialogDesc: Confirm with a TOTP code to schedule a reset. After the cooldown elapses, you'll be able to confirm and execute it.
admin.resetCooldownNote: Cooldown: one week before confirmation is allowed.
admin.resetNoCooldownNote: Cooldown is disabled by NO_RESET_COOLDOWN — confirmation will be available immediately.
admin.resetConfirmDialogDesc: This will permanently destroy all data. Confirm with a TOTP code.
admin.resetSudoActiveNote: 2FA is currently active for this session — TOTP code is optional.
admin.inviteEmailHint: Lock this invite to a specific email address
admin.inviteNoteHint: Shown in the invite email and in this list
admin.hashedInviteCopyHint: The link for this legacy hashed invite cannot be recovered.
admin.oauthSlugHint: Part of the callback URL. Can't be changed later.
admin.oauthNameHint: The text on the sign-in button. Leave blank to use the provider's name.
admin.oauthLeaveBlankToKeep: Saved. Fill in only to replace it.
admin.oauthIconUrlHint: An HTTPS image, ideally a square SVG or PNG.
admin.oauthTrustedHint: People who use two-step verification aren't asked for their code after signing in this way. Turn off to always ask.
admin.oauthIssuerUrlHint: Provider issuer URL — used for OIDC auto-discovery
admin.oauthDiscoverFailed: Discovery failed — check the issuer URL and try again
admin.oauthMigrateBanner: Legacy OAuth credentials found in site settings ({{providers}}). Migrate them to OAuth sources to enable multi-provider support.
admin.oauthMigrateAlreadyDone: All legacy providers are already migrated.
admin.ipv6RateLimitPrefixHint: IPv6 addresses sharing this prefix count as one client (64 = a /64 subnet, 128 = each address).
admin.gpgChallengePrefixHint: Additional lines inserted after the site header in the GPG login challenge text. Leave empty for no prefix.
admin.gpgChallengePrefixPlaceholder: I authorize this login as account owner.
admin.sudoModeTtlHint: After confirming 2FA, skip further prompts from the same app for this long. 0 turns it off; 5–15 is typical.
admin.requireCaptchaFor2faHint: Also require a captcha whenever an app asks the user to confirm with 2FA.
admin.secretsMigrateDesc: Encrypts stored client secrets, sign-in source credentials, GitHub tokens and sensitive settings. Safe to run again.
admin.secretsMigrateStatusBound: Encryption key ready. Still unencrypted — apps: {{apps}}, sources: {{sources}}, GitHub tokens: {{pats}}, settings: {{cfg}}.
admin.secretsMigrateStatusUnbound: No encryption key yet. Add the SECRETS_KEY binding to wrangler.jsonc and redeploy first.
admin.d1SecretsMigrateDesc: Stores sign-in tokens and codes as hashes and encrypts authenticator seeds and webhook secrets. Existing tokens keep working; safe to run again.
admin.d1SecretsMigrateStatusBound: Encryption key ready. Items still to convert: {{total}}.
admin.migrateRecoveryCodesDesc: Hashes any backup codes still stored as plain text. Existing codes keep working.
admin.migrateRecoveryCodesSuccess: Migrated {{count}} user(s) to hashed recovery codes
admin.migrateTeamsAsUsersDesc: Fixes apps moved into teams so they show the team as their owner everywhere. Safe to run again.
admin.migrateImageProxyDesc: Run once after upgrading so existing avatars, icons and README images keep loading. Safe to run again.
admin.avatarProxyConvertWebp: Convert avatars to WebP (needs Cloudflare Images)
admin.imageProxyDeleteConfirm: Delete this mapping? The URL will stop serving until something re-registers it.
admin.imageProxySweepHint: Remove images nothing uses anymore. This also runs automatically.
admin.publicProfilesDesc: Let users publish a profile at /u/<username>. These defaults apply to fields users haven't set.
admin.publicProfilesFieldDefaultsHint: Default visibility per field. Updating a default propagates to every user who hasn't set an explicit preference for that field.
admin.defaultProfileShowGpgKeys: Show GPG public keys by default
admin.defaultProfileShowJoinedTeams: Show user's joined teams by default (also gates appearance in team member lists)
admin.profileReadmeMaxBytesHint: Hard cap on the markdown source for a user's profile README. 1 KB minimum, 1 MB maximum.
admin.githubReadmeTokenHint: Fetches GitHub profile READMEs for users without their own token, avoiding GitHub's 60-per-hour limit. Stored unencrypted.
admin.githubReadmeCacheTtlHint: How long to serve a cached GitHub profile README before issuing a conditional refresh. 60 minimum, 604800 (1 week) maximum.
admin.teamProfileDefaultsHint: Defaults for team public profiles. Same NULL-means-follow-default semantics as the user fields.
admin.defaultTeamProfileShowMemberCount: Team: show member count by default
admin.defaultTeamProfileShowApps: Team: show team-owned apps by default
admin.defaultTeamProfileShowDomains: Team: show verified domains by default
admin.defaultTeamProfileShowMembers: Team: show member list by default (each member's own setting still applies)
admin.defaultTeamProfileShowSubTeams: Team: show sub-teams list on public profile by default
admin.webhooksMigrateDesc: Import webhooks from the old webhook system into the new audit-log webhook system (as General Webhooks). Safe to run more than once.
admin.stagedDissolveTitle: Dissolve team and delete its accounts
admin.stagedDissolveBody: Accounts created from {{name}}'s invite links are deactivated now and deleted after the grace period. Members with their own {{siteName}} accounts aren't affected.
admin.stagedDissolveConfirmLabel: Type the team name ({{name}}) to confirm
admin.enableInviteRegistrationHint: Lets authorised teams hand out links that create accounts. Each team still needs its own grant under Admin → Teams.
admin.inviteRegMaxUsesCapHint: Ceiling on the usage limit a team may set. This is the only hard bound on registration volume.
admin.inviteRegRatePerHourHint: Per-IP limiting cannot bound a link shared to thousands of people; this can.
admin.pendingTtlHoursHint: Accounts that never finish joining are deleted after this.
admin.dissolveGraceHoursHint: Between deactivating a dissolved team’s accounts and deleting them.
admin.restrictedCapsLabel: Features granted to invite-registered accounts (all denied by default)
admin.dbDangerNotice: Changes here skip all checks and are audited. A bad write can lock everyone out.
admin.dbWhereHint: Raw SQL, without the WHERE keyword. Press Enter to apply.
admin.dbNotEditable: This table has no primary key, so rows can't be addressed individually. Use the SQL console to change them.
admin.dbDeleteRowBody: This deletes one row from {{table}} immediately. It cannot be undone.
admin.dbNotNullHint: NOT NULL — leaving this empty will fail
admin.dbSqlHint: Runs against the live D1 database ({{tables}} tables). Separate multiple statements with semicolons — they run in one transaction.
admin.dbWriteWarning: Write mode is on. Statements that modify data will execute against the live database.
admin.dbConfirmWriteTitle: Run this against the live database?
admin.dbConfirmWriteBody: Write mode is on, so this runs for real. Read it once more:
admin.teamOwnerHint: Leave empty to own the team yourself.
admin.dbReadOnlyNotice: This instance's database console is in read-only mode (D1_CONSOLE). You can browse tables and run SELECT queries; writes are refused.
admin.emailChangeHint: Changing the address clears its verified status.
admin.noPasswordSocialOnly: No password — signs in with a linked provider
admin.noFactors: This account has no second factor enrolled.
admin.setPasswordWarning: The user is not notified and will not know this password. Give it to them over a channel you trust, and have them change it.
admin.reset2faBody: Removes every authenticator, passkey and backup code. Afterwards the password alone signs in, so be sure who you're helping.
admin.actionsAreAudited: Actions here are recorded in the platform log and in this user's own audit log.
admin.noTeams: Not a member of any team.
admin.userAuditHint: Everything this account did, and everything a site administrator did to it.
admin.kvPrefixHint: KV has no schema — filter by prefix. Press Enter to apply.
admin.kvTtlHint: Leave empty for no expiry. KV's minimum is 60 seconds.
admin.kvProtectedReason: Hidden: this key signs sessions, so reading it would let someone sign in as anyone. Deleting it rotates it.
admin.kvPurgeTitle: Delete every key under this prefix?
admin.kvPurgeBody: This deletes every key starting with "{{prefix}}" in the {{namespace}} namespace. Key material is skipped. It cannot be undone.
admin.kvPurged: {{deleted}} keys deleted, {{skipped}} skipped as key material
admin.kvPurgeMore: More keys remain under this prefix — run it again.
admin.domainForceVerifyBody: Marks {{domain}} verified without a DNS check. Only do this if you've confirmed ownership another way; it's logged as an admin override.
admin.domainDeleteBody: This removes {{domain}} from its owner. Apps relying on it for verified status will lose that badge.
admin.transferAppHint: The client ID and secret stay the same, so existing integrations keep working.
admin.revokeAppBody: Deletes all of this app's tokens, codes and consents. Users will need to authorize it again.
admin.revokeGrantsHint: Signs this account out of every app by deleting its OAuth tokens and consents. Personal access tokens are revoked above.
admin.liftRestrictionTitle: Lift the restriction on this account?
admin.liftRestrictionBody: The account becomes a normal one: it can create things, join other teams, and outlives its team. This can't be undone.
admin.revokeSessionsDesc: Deletes every active session on the instance ({{count}} right now). Everyone has to sign in again. OAuth tokens are not affected.
admin.revokeGrantBody: {{app}} loses this permission. Its current tokens work until they expire; revoke the app under Applications to end them now.
admin.maintenanceDesc: Scheduled tasks you can run now instead of waiting. They normally run on {{schedule}}.
admin.revokeInviteBody: The link stops working now. Accounts already created with it ({{uses}} for {{team}}) stay; manage them under Users.
admin.noRulesets: No custom rules — using the per-event preferences ({{count}} set).
admin.selectAllOnPage: Select every account on this page
admin.bulkOverLimit: {{count}} accounts selected — at most {{limit}} per action. Deselect some.
admin.bulkDeleteBody: Permanently deletes {{count}} accounts and everything they own, including apps. Your own account and protected accounts are skipped.
admin.noticeBodyHint: Markdown. Rendered through the same sanitizer as profile READMEs.
admin.noticeAudienceHint_public: Also shown on the sign-in and registration pages — the right choice for planned downtime.
admin.noticeAudienceHint_users: Everyone with an account, once they sign in.
admin.noticeAudienceHint_team: Direct members of the team you name below.
admin.noticeStartsHint: Leave empty to show as soon as it is published.
admin.noticeEndsHint: Leave empty to show until you unpublish it.
admin.resetDismissals: Show again to the {{count}} who dismissed it
admin.dismissalsReset: {{count}} dismissals cleared — the notice is back for them
admin.deleteNoticeBody: {{title}} is removed for everyone, along with the record of who dismissed it. Unpublishing keeps it as a draft instead.
admin.dbAppendOnlyNotice: The audit log ({{tables}}) can't be changed here, so every admin action stays accountable.

userPage.restrictionDesc: This account was created through a team invite and is limited to that team until the restriction is lifted.

userPage.deleteSelfDesc: You can't delete your own account from here.
userPage.sessionsDesc: Where the account is signed in to this site, with the addresses each session was used from.
userPage.endAllBody: Signs the account out on every device. Apps it has authorized stay signed in.
userPage.notificationsDesc: Custom notification rules. Only counts are shown, not where messages go.
userPage.resetRulesBody: Deletes the account's custom rules. It goes back to the default per-event settings.
